caption: The video captures a moving view across calm, rippled water, bordered by a steep, forested cliff and a low mist band hovering at its base. In the foreground a log boom of long floating logs runs diagonally across the lower scene, carrying several small perched birds and a yellow-green marker near its middle. Over time the foreground arrangement, mist band, and cliff drift toward the left while the viewpoint continuously translates. The boom's diagonal angle flattens slightly as the viewpoint shifts, consistent with parallax. The birds stay on the logs, making only minor posture adjustments. The mist subtly thickens and shifts shape near the cliff base, while the water shows small ripples. New portions of the boom and cliff enter from the right as existing foreground elements move leftward.
